verdict.rationale: Clerk's changelog announces Admin Logs, an audit trail of Dashboard admin actions across the workspace. Its webhooks can push user lifecycle events (e.g. user created/updated) to an external endpoint, which a team could relay to a SIEM themselves. That covers only a thin slice of the story: missing for 10: a documented audit log of authentication activity (sign-ins, MFA, failures), tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees, native SIEM streaming or export for the audit logs, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration of Admin Logs.
